label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude DevFleet mission DAG and orchestration tools. Tools: plan_project(prompt) -> project_id + mission DAG; create_project(name, path?, description?) -> project_id; create_mission(project_id, title, prompt, depends_on?, auto_dispatch?) -> mission; depends_on is list of mission ID strings (e.g., ["abc-123"]); auto_dispatch=true auto-starts when deps met. dispatch_mission(mission_id, model?, max_turns?) starts agent; cancel_mission stops agent; wait_for_mission blocks (default 600s); get_mission_status checks progress; get_report returns structured report (files_changed, what_done, errors, next_steps); get_dashboard system overview; list_projects, list_missions. Flow: plan_project -> show plan -> get approval -> dispatch first mission (empty depends_on) -> remaining auto-dispatch as deps complete (auto_dispatch=true). Concurrency: 3 concurrent agents default (DEVFLEET_MAX_AGENTS); missions queue when slots full, auto-dispatch as slots free. Guidelines: confirm plan before dispatch, include mission titles/IDs in status, read report before retrying failed mission, check dashboard for slots, no circular deps, isolated worktrees auto-merge on completion.
